summary: Strict shuffle-control scoring bypasses the --hf-revision pin when local payloads exist; re-score after re-dispatch silently uses stale data while claiming the new revision. Close before production.
evidence: issue602_score.py _resolve_followup_payloads (commit 720e12af0): 'if not local.exists():' gates the only revision=args.hf_revision download; existing files load unchecked; revision_recorded = args.hf_revision. Model guard passes same-model stale payloads; downloaded sidecars lack upload_revision so no sidecar check possible. Fix: strict+--hf-revision -> always resolve via bk.hub_download at the pinned revision (cache-backed), or fail loud on unverifiable local files.
